submissions.settings.title: Form settings
submissions.settings.notify_help: Off: messages are only kept here.
submissions.settings.recipients_help: Up to 10 addresses, separated by commas. Empty: the contact email in General settings, else the first administrator.
submissions.settings.attachments_help: PDF, images, text, Word, Excel or PowerPoint. Files are private: only people who can open this page can download them.
submissions.settings.error_recipients: Recipients must be plain email addresses (at most 10).
submissions.settings.error_max_mb: The file size must be a whole number of megabytes from 1 to 20.
intake.intro: Share a school safety or violence concern with the site operator’s designated reviewers. No account is required. Provide only the information needed for an initial review.
intake.received_help: Your report has been stored for private human review. Keep this reference for a follow-up. Receipt does not confirm an investigation, response time or outcome.
intake.minimize: Describe facts you observed and distinguish them from what you heard. Avoid children’s names, exact home addresses, identity documents and unnecessary personal details. Attachments are not accepted.
intake.consent: I understand that this information will be stored and reviewed by the site operator’s authorized reviewers, and I agree to submit it.
intake.emergency: This is not an emergency channel and is not continuously monitored. If someone is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services or a trusted responsible adult now.
intake.privacy: Reports are not published, sent by email or passed to AI. Contact details are optional. This service does not promise anonymous browsing or end-to-end encryption; ordinary server access logs may exist.
intake.invalid: Review the form: consent and a description are required, email must be valid if supplied, and follow-up needs a previous reference.
intake.admin_intro: Restricted human review. These records are separate from contact messages, public content, search and AI. Opening a report is audited.
intake.note_help: Notes stay inside this restricted record. A status change does not contact the reporter or confirm findings. Up to 100 review updates per record.
intake.conflict: This record changed. Reload the page before saving again.
intake.review_invalid: Choose a valid status and a note of at most 3,000 characters. The review history limit is 100 updates.
intake.settings_help: Enable only when your organization has designated reviewers, a privacy notice and an appropriate response process. This is a private intake queue, not an emergency or case-management service.
intake.enable: Enable public incident and follow-up forms
intake.disabled: Intake is disabled. Existing records remain available to authorized reviewers.
intake.settings_boundary: Review access requires intake.review; ordinary editors are excluded. No email, uploads, exports, public lookup or AI forwarding is provided. Reports and reviewer notes are encrypted with the application key; preserve that key.
